candidates.tagline: The car brand that ran an ad with no cars just unveiled a £130,000 car
candidates.story: Jaguar's 2024 'Copy Nothing' rebrand campaign showed no cars at all, sent European sales crashing 97.5%, and on 7 Oct 2026 the company finally unveiled the £130,000 Type 01 EV in New York.
candidates.why_funny: A company that forgot to put cars in its own car commercial is now selling the most expensive car in its history.
candidates.alt: Jaguar Type 01 electric GT on display at its New York reveal, a wide silver luxury car with sweeping lines

candidates.tagline: Gatorade — famous for neon colors — forgot to list the yellow dye on 122,000 cases
candidates.story: PepsiCo recalled 122,021 cases of Gatorade Lemon Lime and Orange on 5 Oct 2026 because the labels omitted Yellow No. 5 and Yellow No. 6, the dyes that give the drink its signature fluorescent color.
candidates.why_funny: The one thing Gatorade is universally known for — its electric, eye-watering colors — was somehow left off the label.
candidates.alt: Row of brightly colored Gatorade bottles on a store shelf, vivid yellows, oranges and greens
